entities.summary: Lior Lubin was an Israeli professional basketball coach and onetime national team player. He was born in Ramat Gan, Israel. In 2000, he was the Israeli Premier League Assists Leader. His last coaching position was for Hapoel Be'er Sheva of the Israeli Basketball Premier League.
